# Rule 8 - No Hacking, Exploiting, or Using Macros
[italic]Exceptions for external accessibility tools may be considered. If you need to use them, ask in admin help (F1) for further information.[/italic]
Any external tool or program used to gain an advantage or modify the client in some way that gives you an advantage is not allowed. Breaking this rule may result in a [bold]permanent ban[/bold] that is unable to be appealed.
## Precedents - Use of the copy and paste functions for text is allowed. - Do not use any external software to give yourself an unfair advantage over other players. - Do not modify your game client in any way that gives you an unfair advantage over players nor for any malicious reasons. - Do not use macros — scripts, programs, or in-built hardware features — to automatically execute a series of inputs. (Using the game's built-in feature of binding a key to a command is allowed.) - Do not exploit bugs. Report any bugs you find in admin help (F1). - Do not intentionally attempt to crash or lag the server or other players. - Do not spam or otherwise create an excessive number of entities that contain an AI (such as slimes or monkeys). This also applies to excessive stacking of entities/structures with effects like lights/smoke.
